title: Zikre ghame hussain se
body:
Zikre ghame hussain se mehfil saji rahi
gul ho gaya charaagh magar roushni rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ke baad zeest me kya dilkashi rahi
laila tamaam umr yahi sonchti rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime furaaat se to hataae gaye magar
Abbase naamdaar ki tyori chadhi rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas lene aaye jo maidaan ki riza
zainab bas apne baazuo'n ko dekhti rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
Ashke ghame hussain ka toota na silsila
roomaale fatima me hamesha nami rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
balwe me berida sare zainab ko dekhkar
Allah jaane kaise qayaamat ruki rahi
